page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-48-lssd is a member of the c4n server family, featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core allocation of 7.75 GB per vCPU. This configuration does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and local storage is specified as None.

With a memory-to-vCPU ratio of nearly 1:8, this server type is positioned for memory-intensive workloads that require dedicated compute resources without the overhead of hardware acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, avoiding the performance fluctuations associated with shared-core environments. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per core allows for consolidated hosting of memory-bound applications, optimizing resource utilization within a single virtual machine.

The hardware profile of this instance is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines. The combination of 48 dedicated physical threads and 372.0 GB of RAM supports concurrent execution of memory-heavy processes, making it suitable for backend services and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
